question: A map app knows the travel time of every road. Plain BFS finds the route with the fewest roads. Why is that not good enough here?
options: Roads take different times, so fewer roads can still mean a longer trip
BFS is too slow for maps
explanation: One 60-minute road loses to three 5-minute roads. Dijkstra always settles the closest place next, so it handles different road lengths (as long as none is negative).
